Observation:
HLA-DRA appears as a ligand in the MHC-II pathway originating from several tumor cell types with an Ephys_1 phenotype (e.g., cycling_tumor, AC_like_tumor, OPC_GABA_AC_like_tumor, OPC_GABA_like_tumor) in communication with TAM1/TAM2/microglia (tool=cellchat_lookup, file=all_significant_interactions.csv, gene=HLA-DRA, ephys=Ephys_1, compartment=tumor, role=either, n_hits=9).

HLA-DRA also appears as an Ephys_1-high differentially expressed gene (DEG) in several tumor cell types (e.g., cycling_tumor, OPC_GABA_AC_like_tumor, AC_like_tumor, OPC_GABA_like_tumor) (tool=deg_lookup, file=combined_Ephys2_vs_Ephys1_significant_DEGs_by_IDH_and_cluster.csv, gene=HLA-DRA, pooled=False, n_hits=10).

Interpretation:
Yes, HLA-DRA appears as both an MHC-II CellChat ligand originating from Ephys_1 tumor cells and an Ephys_1-high tumor DEG. Neurons are not a labeled identity in the provided traces.
